title: Quail Patch 2 Part 4
message: BIG Sand Box 3D update (v26.11.07): NEW controls for Sand Box 3D, hotbars, and on-screen buttons, along with switching from "Free Fly Mode" to "Player Mode" toggles. Rift Runners 2D update (v3.0.0): A certain "hard cap" to most enemies, this means that RR2D isn't as hard to beat anymore. Weapons buffed, shop upgrades now better. A new option after you die in RR2D; 599 Shards to revive yourself and continue playing.
